name: trackiq-amazon-demand-forecast
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Demand Forecast and Reorder Plan
summary: Turns trailing sales and last year's seasonal shape into a week-by-week demand forecast per Amazon product, then converts it into order quantities and order-by dates that account for lead time, safety stock and the service level the brand wants — with the forecast error stated so nobody treats it as certain.
